# Bongshai Steel — Steel Building Manufacturer & Exporter

> Bongshai Steel designs, fabricates, and exports pre-engineered steel buildings from Bangladesh worldwide: heavy industrial factory sheds, multi-story structural steel apartment buildings, duplex steel villas, resort cottages, and modified shipping container houses.

## Company Summary
- **Company Name**: Bongshai Steel
- **Factory / Head Office**: House #18, Road #18, Sector #10, Uttara C/A, Dhaka – 1230, Bangladesh
- **Contact Phone / WhatsApp**: +8801789-949060
- **Official Email**: sales@bongshaisteel.com
- **Website**: https://www.bongshaisteel.com/
- **Export Markets**: Worldwide, including USA (AISC 360 / IBC 2024), Canada (CSA S16 / NBC), Australia (AS/NZS 4100 / NCC), Middle East, Africa, and South Asia.
- **Structural Engineering Standards**: AISC 360 (USA), CSA S16 (Canada), AS/NZS 4100 & AS/NZS 4600 (Australia), Eurocode 3, BNBC 2020, and AWS D1.1 Welding.
- **Major Ocean Freight Ports**: USA (Los Angeles, Long Beach, Houston, NY/NJ), Canada (Vancouver, Montreal, Halifax), Australia (Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Fremantle).
- **Sister Company**: Bongshai Housing (https://bongshaihousing.com/) — residential real estate and prefab housing within Bangladesh.
- **Pricing**: Not published. Every building is engineered to the buyer's site, span, and load requirements — request an official quote for pricing.

## Product Lines
Only Prefab Buildings currently has a published model catalog (72 models across 5 sub-categories). The other product lines below are real, planned lines with no published models yet — no invented models or specs are listed for them.

### 1. Prefab Buildings (72 models)
- Steel Factory Building — BH-IS-1001 to BH-IS-1012 (12 models): SS400/Q355 heavy portal frame, 10–50 Ton EOT crane ready, PU insulation.
- Structural Steel Building — BH-TSB-101 to BH-TSB-112 (12 models): Multi-story steel apartment towers, composite decking concrete slab, engineered to international structural standards.
- Duplex Steel Building — BH-DV-201 to BH-DV-212 (12 models): Modern 2-story luxury steel duplexes, 4 Bed/4 Bath, 60-day rapid build.
- Steel Cottage House — BH-CH-401 to BH-CH-412 & BH-TH-701 to BH-TH-712 (24 models): Eco resort prefab cottages, fiber cement cladding, fast on-site setup.
- Steel Container House — BH-CH-501 to BH-CH-512 (12 models): 20ft & 40ft modified container site offices & luxury homes.

Structural steel fabrication for industrial and commercial projects.
